resolution.note: seed write creates tasks/ when adopt left none; test writeSeedTask on a bare clone

title: Outside acceptance rows never fail setup with a missing task file
body:
Why: Fable direction 1115e slice 6. .krn/runs/outside/summary.txt holds five 'ENOENT tasks/t-*.json' not-run rows with no named fix.
Outcome: the row runner creates or finds the task file the row names; if already fixed, a test pins it and status names the fixing SHA.
Files: scripts/outside-acceptance.ts and its test.
Proof: a red test on the real runner with a fake worker turns green. Free.
